integrity: Exact finite-state recursions with symbolic polynomial signs and independently enumerated rational paths; no stochastic-simulation inference and no independent expert certification.
limitations: Finite connected simple undirected unweighted graphs of orders two to four only; homogeneous independent exponential infection and removal; no conclusions for larger networks or other epidemic models. Historical priority awaits independent examination of unlocated tables and source literature.
title: Four vertices are sharp for a peak-capacity reversal in the Markovian SIR model
